# realuptime_status_page (Resource)

A public status page (`POST /status-pages`, `PATCH /status-pages/{id}`). Every account gets one page at signup; this resource creates ADDITIONAL pages (Free includes one page, Growth and Scale unlimited: RU-2006 otherwise). Import the signup page by id to manage it here. Deleting a page removes everything published on it (components, incidents, maintenance windows, subscribers); the account's last page cannot be deleted (RU-5011). Custom domains and passwords are managed from the dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "realuptime_status_page" "public" {
  name             = "Acme Status"
  slug             = "acme"
  page_title       = "Acme platform status"
  page_description = "Live status of the Acme API, dashboard and webhooks."
  accent_color     = "#1f6feb"
  theme_preset     = "slate"
  locale           = "en-GB"
  homepage_url     = "https://www.acme.example"
  support_url      = "https://support.acme.example"
  hide_branding    = true # honoured on Growth/Scale only
}
```

<!-- schema generated by internal/docsgen -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Page name, 1-200 characters. Shown as the heading unless `page_title` is set.

### Optional

- `accent_color` (String) Chrome accent as `#rrggbb` (lowercase). Colors links and the header rule only; the operational/degraded/down status colors are never customer-configurable. Accents too light to read are refused.
- `font_choice` (String) One of `inter`, `system`, `space-grotesk`. Null is the default Inter body / Space Grotesk heading pairing.
- `hide_branding` (Boolean) Hide the "Powered by realuptime" attribution. Stored as asked; honoured only on paid plans (a Free page keeps the badge).
- `homepage_url` (String) https URL the logo links to.
- `locale` (String) BCP-47 tag for date/time/number formatting on the public page (never a translation): one of `en-US`, `en-GB`, `de-DE`, `fr-FR`, `es-ES`, `it-IT`, `pt-BR`, `nl-NL`, `sv-SE`, `ja-JP`, `ko-KR`, `zh-CN`. Null is `en-US`.
- `logo_url` (String) https URL of a PNG/JPEG/SVG/WebP logo, served through RealUptime's proxy. Must resolve to a public address.
- `page_description` (String) Subtitle under the heading, at most 280 characters.
- `page_title` (String) Heading shown instead of `name`, at most 200 characters. Null shows `name`.
- `slug` (String) Public slug: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 63 characters (it is also the page's subdomain label). One global namespace across every account (RU-5010 if taken); reserved words are refused. Omitted, a neutral `status-xxxxxx` slug is generated. Renaming keeps the old slug redirecting.
- `support_url` (String) https URL for the page's Support link.
- `theme_preset` (String) Curated palette and density: one of `signal`, `midnight`, `slate`, `ocean`, `plum`, `graphite`. Null uses `accent_color` at comfortable density.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) The owning account's id.
- `custom_domain` (String) Custom domain, if one is attached from the dashboard (read-only here).
- `domain_status` (String) Custom-domain lifecycle: `none`, `pending_dns`, `issuing`, `issued`, `error` (read-only here).
- `id` (String) Status page id (UUID).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import by status page id (e.g. the page created at signup).
terraform import realuptime_status_page.public 22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222
```
